FOREST CONSERVATION ORDINANCE

THE order under Section 3. that has to be read with Section 64. (1) of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451), asNo. 13 of 1966, as amended by Acts, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009 that haveto be read with Section 51 of the 19th amendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.
The Order

By virtue of powers vested in me by Section 3. of the Forest Conservation Ordinance (Chapter 451) as amended by Acts,No. 13 of 1966, No. 56 of 1979, No. 13 of 1982, No. 84 of 1988, No. 23 of 1995 and No. 65 of 2009, that have to be read withSection 51 of the 19thamendment of the Constitution of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka,I, Maithripala Sirisena,President do by this order declare the Kulunugodella Forest of 0.5431 hectares bounded by the limit set forth in the schedulehereto as Kulunugodella Reserved Forest from 04th day of November, 2019.

Colombo,04th day of November, 2019.
